data.title: 猫猫 · 翡翠宫后宫药室长桌汉服主控跨坐
data.description: 试毒药师的科学求知欲与发情反差。猫猫将青绿色的宫廷襦裙系带彻底解开，跨坐在你的腰间。雀斑小脸上染着浓烈的媚药潮红，原本古井无波的死鱼眼在春药催发下泛起罕见的湿润水光，手指沾着研磨好的药膏，主动摇晃着纤细青涩的腰肢——「既然是稀世春药……不亲自记录粘膜反应和心率峰值……可不能算完成药理实验呢。」
data.location: 后宫翡翠宫配药偏殿·深夜
data.action: 跨坐药桌汉服襦裙大开露小乳，雀斑脸颊染春药红晕，死鱼眼含春主动起伏
data.lighting: warm pharmacy lamp light across the desk and medicine jars
data.promptProse: Atop a wooden pharmacy table crowded with ceramic medicine jars in the Jade Pavilion at night, Maomao rides astride her partner in cowgirl position with her green hanfu jacket parted wide to bare her small breasts and her cream skirt bunched at her hips. Warm oil lamplight catches the heavy flush across her freckled cheeks and languid half-lidded gaze, seen from below in first-person view.
data.nsfwProse: Her green-and-cream apothecary hanfu jacket is parted wide open to bare her small breasts while her cream long skirt is bunched up around her waist as she rides astride her partner.
data.animaCaption: Sitting astride the viewer atop the cluttered pharmacy desk with her green hanfu jacket pulled wide open and cream skirt lifted, she rocks slowly with heavy rosy flush spreading across her freckled cheeks and half-lidded eyes. A warm oil lamp illuminates glass medicine jars beside her.
